description: Runs the request application's original services and request handlers against a disposable PostgreSQL database, one process per actor; the coordinator plays the HTTP client.

claimTask.description: Read the assignee, then assign unconditionally; returns whether the caller claimed the task.

claimTaskAtomic.description: UPDATE ... WHERE assignee IS NULL RETURNING; returns whether a row changed.

recordSignup.description: One INSERT with a database-generated key, then the 201 response.

recordSignupIdempotent.description: One INSERT keyed by the request id, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, then the 201 response.

recordView.description: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET hits = hits + 1.

reserveHandle.description: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (handle) DO UPDATE SET owner = excluded.owner RETURNING *; returns whether a row came back.

reserveHandleIfFree.description: The same with DO UPDATE ... WHERE owner IS NULL.
